key_concepts: Solids have definite shape and volume
Liquids have no definite shape but have definite volume
Gases have no definite shape and no definite volume
Porous materials absorb water because they have spaces inside
Non-porous materials do not allow water to pass through
Biodegradable materials decay while non-biodegradable materials do not
Sunlight, soil, and water contribute to the decaying process
Bending, pressing, hammering, or cutting solid materials changes only their physical appea
Heating can cause melting, evaporation, and condensation
Homogeneous mixtures have uniform appearance and cannot be distinguished
Heterogeneous mixtures have materials that can still be identified
Waste materials can be classified as biodegradable or non-biodegradable
